product_overview: This product is a sophisticated node-based scene editor integrated within a project management platform. It supports user authentication, project and scene management, interactive node editing with real-time collaboration, timeline editing for scene/video clips, and user profile management.
core_goals: Enable users to authenticate securely and manage their profile.
Provide an interactive and user-friendly dashboard and project detail views.
Support detailed node-based scene editing with features like selection, deletion, undo, and auto-layout.
Ensure real-time multi-user collaboration within the scene editor for synchronous updates.
Implement timeline views with responsive data calculation and clip management.
Maintain responsive, stable, and clear UI/UX layouts across all screen sizes.
key_features: Authentication: User login and registration ensuring secure access.
Dashboard: Central hub displaying user projects and quick access.
Project Detail Page: Manage projects extensively including loading and scene overview.
Node-based Scene Editor: Interactive node selection, deletion, keyboard shortcuts, history undo, and auto-layout features.
Real-time Collaboration: Socket-based room joining for multi-user editing, cursor and state synchronization, and cleanup on exit.
Timeline View: Displays video clips with real-time recalculations of durations and thumbnails.
User Profile Management: Viewing and editing user profile information including updates.
Robust Data Loading: Asynchronous and sequential loading of project and scene data with error handling and loading state indication.
Responsive UI: Consistent button placement, non-overlapping panels, and layouts adapting to screen size changes.
user_flow_summary: User authenticates via login or registration page.
Upon login, user accesses dashboard displaying available projects.
User selects a project and navigates to project detail page where project and scenes data load asynchronously with loading indicators.
User opens scene editor to interact with node canvas, performing node selection, deletion, undo, and auto-layout functions.
Multiple users join the collaboration room enabling real-time cursor and status updates on nodes.
User switches to timeline view to see updated clips computed from scene nodes with live duration and thumbnail recalculations.
User accesses and edits their profile in profile page with save functionality.
User logs out or leaves the page, triggering socket disconnection and cleanup processes.
validation_criteria: Verify URL parameters for projectId and sceneId are parsed correctly on page load.
Ensure Promise.all successfully resolves loadProject and loadScenes API calls in order.
Validate error handling when nodeStore.loadSceneNodes API fails, with appropriate UI feedback.
Confirm loading spinner or status indicator is shown during data fetch lifecycle methods.
Test node selection and deselection events trigger and update states as expected.
Verify keyboard shortcuts Delete and Backspace delete nodes only when input fields are not focused.
Validate Ctrl+Z undo integrates properly with nodeStore history stack.
Check that handleAutoLayout correctly rearranges nodes without corrupting graph layout.
Confirm collabStore.joinRoom establishes socket connection on scene editor mount.
Ensure collabStore.leaveRoom disconnects socket cleanly on unmount to prevent zombie connections.
Validate real-time updates reflect other users' cursors and state changes instantly.
Check timelineClips recompute immediately upon changes in confirmedVideos data.
Ensure totalDuration sums clip durations accurately and gracefully handles missing thumbnail or version info without rendering errors.
Confirm UI elements like auto-layout button maintain position after drag-and-drop operations.
Test layout responsiveness ensuring no canvas or panel overlap or distortion at smaller screen sizes.
